options.content: ● normal  ● warning  ● alarm  ● bad data  ·  ⌀ 30-day avg  ·  — off  ·  ⓘ details  ·  New dashboard for review: limits not yet set, so values show in white

panels.description: Running when UF permeate flow is above 1 m³/h.

targets.query: SELECT last("202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow") AS "UF" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.title: UF

panels.description: Running when the RO high-pressure pump draws power.

targets.query: SELECT last("301_p_07_ro_hp_pump_power") AS "RO" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.title: RO

panels.description: UF permeate flow (m³/h) integrated since midnight IST.

targets.query: SELECT integral("202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow", 1h) AS "Today" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow" >= 0

panels.title: UF permeate today

panels.description: Plant power calculated from the MCC energy total (kWh per hour, 10-minute steps). The meter's own power reading reads 0 and is under repair.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total"), 1h) AS "Now" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 40m GROUP BY time(10m) fill(none)
SELECT last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_current") AS "Current" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.title: Plant power

targets.query: SELECT last("202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_calc_suf_tmp") AS "TMP" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_calc_suf_flux") AS "Flux" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_calc_suf_permeability") AS "Permeability" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_lit_01_suf_tank_level") AS "UF tank" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("202_tit_06_suf_permeate_line_temperature") AS "Temperature" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.description: No membrane clean has been recorded: the CIP pump signals have never reported running, and the site does not use the membrane cleaning log form. Will show the time since the last clean once either is in use (the cleaning log form, as at Nanded and Zim Lab, is recommended).

targets.query: SELECT last("202_p_05_suf_cip_pump_run_fb") AS "ran" FROM "plc" WHERE "202_p_05_suf_cip_pump_run_fb" = 1 AND time > now() - 365d

panels.title: Last clean · UF

targets.query: SELECT mean("202_fit_03_suf_permeate_flow") AS "UF permeate" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("302_fit_01_ro_first_stage_inlet_feed_flow") AS "Feed" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("302_fit_03_ro_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("302_fit_03_ro_reject_flow") AS "Reject" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("302_ait_03_ro_combined_permeate_conductivity") AS "Conductivity" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("302_ait_01_ro_combined_permeate_ph") AS "pH" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m
SELECT last("302_ait_02_ro_inlet_orp") AS "Inlet ORP" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 10m

panels.description: Fresh = readings in the last 5 minutes; Late = last reading 5–15 minutes ago; Stale = nothing for 15 minutes.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 15m

panels.title: Data feed

panels.description: Time since the RO CIP pump last ran (run feedback 301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb). Looks back one year.

targets.query: SELECT last("301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb") AS "ran" FROM "plc" WHERE "301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb" = 1 AND time > now() - 365d

panels.title: Last clean · RO (CIP pump)

targets.query: SELECT mean("202_calc_suf_tmp") AS "TMP" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("302_ait_03_ro_combined_permeate_conductivity") AS "Conductivity" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
